references.text: Parallel text about hooks of gold for the inner part of the tabernacle, while verse 11 describes hooks of bronze for the outer covering of goat hair.
The fulfillment of the instruction in Exodus 26:11, where Bezalel and the craftsmen actually made the fifty bronze hooks to fasten the tent cloth together.
Describes how the curtains were to be fastened together, providing context for the use of hooks and loops to make the tabernacle into one unit.
Shows how the tabernacle became a single whole through the fastening, which is the goal described in Exodus 26:11.
The verse describes the making of the loops, which are the necessary prerequisite for the hooks in the source verse.
Describes the necessary preparation (the loops) that enables the hooks in the source verse to fasten the tent together.
